verdict.rationale: Anytype's local API, MCP server, and 'Agents Skill' let external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) read/search/query Anytype data and even run scripts against it, which could surface insights, but this requires plugging in a third-party agent — there's no evidence of a native, built-in AI feature inside Anytype's own UI that proactively generates insights or suggestions from your data. missing for 10: first-party in-app AI insight/suggestion generation (e.g., built-in AI summarization or recommendation feature), evidence of AI-driven Query/View suggestions rather than manual criteria definition, hands-on report of an agent producing actual insights.
